<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: center"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Indicate
by check mark whether the registrant is an emerging growth company as defined in Rule 405 of the Securities Act of 1933 (&#167;230.405
of this chapter) or Rule 12b-2 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 (&#167;240.12b-2 of this chapter).</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Emerging
growth company <span id="xdx_906_edei--EntityEmergingGrowthCompany_c20261102__20261102_zuA8oLHRb4v6"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="AsOf2026-11-02" format="ixt:booleanfalse" id="Fact000028" name="dei:EntityEmergingGrowthCompany">&#9744;</ix:nonNumeric></span></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">If
an emerging growth company, indicate by check mark if the registrant has elected not to use the extended transition period for complying
with any new or revised financial accounting standards provided pursuant to Section 13(a) of the Exchange Act. &#9744;&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<!-- Field: Rule-Page --><div style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%"><div style="border-top: Black 1pt solid; border-bottom: Black 4pt solid; font: 1pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</span></div></div><!-- Field: /Rule-Page -->

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: center"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>


<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 1; Options: NewSection -->
    <div style="border-bottom: Black 1pt solid; margin-bottom: 6pt"><table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font-size: 10pt"><tr style="vertical-align: top; text-align: left"><td style="width: 100%">&#160;</td></tr></table></div>
    <div style="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt"><p style="margin: 0pt">&#160;</p></div>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>&#160;</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Item
8.01. Other Events.</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>&#160;</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">On
November 2, 2026, HyOrc Corporation (the &#8220;Company&#8221;) entered into a Settlement Agreement and Mutual Release (the &#8220;Settlement
Agreement&#8221;) with Daniel S. McKinney (&#8220;McKinney&#8221;) and Coldway Limited, LLC (&#8220;Coldway&#8221;), resolving litigation
styled <i>Daniel McKinney v. HyOrc Corporation, et al.</i>, Case No. A-26-955028-C, pending in the Eighth Judicial District Court of
Clark County, Nevada, Department 30 (the &#8220;Action&#8221;).</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Action concerned, among other things, the affiliate/control classification of McKinney and Coldway on the records of the Company&#8217;s
transfer agent, Transfer Online, Inc. (&#8220;Transfer Online&#8221;), and proposed deposits, transfers or sales of Company securities.
The First Amended Complaint sought damages in excess of $3 million. McKinney and Coldway contend that they are not affiliates of the
Company. The Company disputed liability in the Action.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Under
the Settlement Agreement, McKinney agreed to cause the Action to be dismissed with prejudice, on the merits, as to the Company and each
of the five individual defendants named in the Action, K. Reginald Fubara, Andrea Magalini, Manoharan Sundaralingam, James Anthony McNaught-Davis
and Richard Oblath (collectively, the &#8220;Individual Defendants&#8221;), each of whom is a director of the Company, without an award
of attorneys&#8217; fees or costs to any party. McKinney and Coldway released the Company, the Individual Defendants and related persons
from all claims, known or unknown, arising from or relating to the dispute or facts occurring on or before the effective date of the
Settlement Agreement, and covenanted not to sue on any released claim. The Company released McKinney and Coldway from claims the Company
owns arising from the same dispute. The Individual Defendants are not parties to the Settlement Agreement and do not release any claims,
but are express third-party beneficiaries entitled to enforce the releases, covenants and indemnity in their favor.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">As
part of the settlement, the Company agreed to provide Transfer Online with a limited instruction, in the form attached as Exhibit A to
the Settlement Agreement, stating that the Company does not presently believe that McKinney is an &#8220;affiliate&#8221; of the Company
within the meaning of Rule 144 under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, and authorizing removal solely of the affiliate/control
designations for McKinney and Coldway from Transfer Online&#8217;s records. The instruction is based upon the May 20, 2026 opinion letter
of John L. Stoss, P.C., to the extent applicable, and upon representations and warranties made by McKinney and Coldway in the Settlement
Agreement, including that neither is, or during the preceding 90 days has been, an affiliate of the Company, and that neither is party
to any undisclosed arrangement conferring direct or indirect control of the Company. The instruction is to be delivered at a coordinated
closing with the filing of the stipulation of dismissal. [As of the date of this report, the stipulation of dismissal [has been filed]
and the instruction [has been delivered].] The instruction does not constitute an opinion or authorization regarding the eligibility
of any particular securities for resale or transfer, and the Company has not agreed to issue a legal opinion, to warrant that any particular
shares may be deposited, transferred or sold, or to certify nonaffiliate status on an ongoing basis.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
settlement requires no monetary payment by the Company or any other party as settlement consideration. Each party bears its own attorneys&#8217;
fees, expenses and costs incurred in the Action and the settlement, other than amounts recoverable under the indemnification provisions
described below.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">McKinney
and Coldway agreed, jointly and severally, to indemnify, defend and hold harmless the Company, the Individual Defendants and the other
released persons from losses, including reasonable attorneys&#8217; fees, arising from any materially false, misleading or incomplete
representation or warranty made by McKinney or Coldway in the Settlement Agreement, any undisclosed arrangement conferring control that
renders such a representation materially inaccurate, or any breach of their covenants under the Settlement Agreement. The Settlement
Agreement also contains other customary provisions, including covenants not to sue and enforcement provisions, and is governed by Nevada
law. The settlement does not constitute an admission of liability or wrongdoing by the Company or any Individual Defendant, or an admission
by McKinney or Coldway regarding past affiliate status.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
foregoing description of the Settlement Agreement does not purport to be complete and is qualified in its entirety by reference to the
full text of the Settlement Agreement, including Exhibit A thereto, a copy of which is filed as Exhibit 10.1 to this Current Report on
Form 8-K and incorporated herein by reference.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>&#160;</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Item
9.01. Financial Statements and Exhibits.</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>&#160;</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>(d)
Exhibits.</b></span></p>
